story.text: No credential without both: a human approval carrying a written rationale, and a passed understanding challenge. Withholding either sandboxes the agent no matter what it scored.
There is a third light on the panel: the volume. Both gates can stand open and det(Σ) below the fly threshold still decides sandbox — see [[Vera and Mirage]].

When all three align, a Verifiable Relationship Credential issues: W3C VC 2.0 shape, exactly two REAL ed25519 signatures over the same canonical bytes — issuer and subject, unforgeable alone. Then comes [[The Verdict Lexicon]].
